arguments.analyst: Round 1: observed evidence shows single/double substitutions (I171V:G191S, T62S:M233L) reach ~3.88-3.90 log brightness, while clustered three-mutation designs including L195R or Q183L collapse to ~1.30. Menu items are conservative single/small edits near 3.5-3.6; hypothesis: modest hydrophobic/buried substitutions retain or improve brightness, and low-scoring menu items (L195P, K101R clusters) predict loss.
arguments.hypothesis: Brightness is preserved by conservative single substitutions (e.g., F46Y, N170H, V193A) but disrupted by proline/charge clusters (e.g., L195P-containing C21/C23); testing C13/C33 against C23/C21 will discriminate.

decision.analyst: Round 1: observed evidence shows single/double substitutions (I171V:G191S, T62S:M233L) reach ~3.88-3.90 log brightness, while clustered three-mutation designs including L195R or Q183L collapse to ~1.30. Menu items are conservative single/small edits near 3.5-3.6; hypothesis: modest hydrophobic/buried substitutions retain or improve brightness, and low-scoring menu items (L195P, K101R clusters) predict loss.
decision.hypothesis: Brightness is preserved by conservative single substitutions (e.g., F46Y, N170H, V193A) but disrupted by proline/charge clusters (e.g., L195P-containing C21/C23); testing C13/C33 against C23/C21 will discriminate.
decision.critic: Estimates are fitted, not measured; C21/C23 uncertainty is high, and L195P harm is inferred from L195R observation, not directly tested.
decision.selection_rationale: Priority tests conservative singletons C33/C13/C48 (~3.58-3.63), mid C29 (~3.49), and low C21 (~2.66) to probe L195P-driven loss versus observations O1/O2.
